messages:
maria: FYI CS reported surprising embed bill: mixed dims in one batch got charged as if all were largest dim

dan: paste request?
maria: ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/12399
 5x512 + 3x1536, billed = 8 * 1536 units

sree: current estimator uses batch-max-dim. that's simple but bad for billing clarity

alek: runtime packs to largest shape to reuse coalesced kernels; avoids internal fragmentation but inflates exposed units

zoe: is customer asking for refund or just transparency?
maria: transparency first. they asked how to avoid this in future

sree: quick wins: (1) add preflight /v1/embeddings/estimate returning per-dim breakdown and conservative estimate; (2) emit telemetry linking request_id -> dim groups; (3) later: runtime smart-split to route same-dim groups separately

dan: preflight low-risk. smart-split increases requests and might hurt p99; need benching
alek: agreed. smart-split reduces billed units for heterogenous batches but will raise scheduler load. I'll bench mixed-dim worst-case

zoe: Console: show per-request expandable breakdown and per-route summary (24h) by dim. small tooltip explaining packing rationale
maria: SDK: add optional estimate() helper and a `X-Embed-Shape-Hint` header. opt-in env var REDWOOD_EMB_SHAPE_PREFLIGHT=1 for early access

sree: metrics: `embed.estimate.requests`, `embed.estimate.delta.p95`, `embed.smart_split.enabled.count` and alert if delta >20%
ingest-bot: canary plan: preflight API at 10% of SDK calls starting 2026-04-12 06:00 UTC; telemetry-only for 2w then consider smart-split toggle

dan: ops note: mark preflight as estimate traffic so it doesn't eat free credits. rate-limit those calls

alek: preflight cheap: run packing heuristics only, return lower_bound and conservative_bound. example breakdown: [{dim:512,count:5,est:2560},{dim:1536,count:3,est:4608}]

zoe: timeline: telemetry + console mock by Friday, preflight canary next week, smart-split feature flag ~3w after canary if metrics look good
maria: action items: Alek bench PR, Zoe console mock, Sree add metrics & alerts, Dan coordinate canary. I'll update CS with preflight link
sree: ack
maria: thanks all :rocket:
